tokens.name: sandstone-red
tokens.usage: Primary. The only colour that carries the mark. Text on marble-ivory (5.8:1) and warm-marble (5.4:1). Never text on india-ink (2.6:1). Brand pack.

tokens.name: marble-ivory
tokens.usage: Primary ground. Text colour on india-ink, sandstone-red and deccani-teal. Brand pack.

tokens.name: warm-marble
tokens.usage: Alternate ground for panels and quiet sections; takes india-ink text (13.9:1). Brand pack.

tokens.name: india-ink
tokens.usage: Text on marble grounds (15.0:1); the only dark ground. Brand pack.

tokens.name: muted-sand
tokens.usage: Body text on india-ink (10.2:1). On sandstone-red only at 24px and up (4.0:1). Brand pack.

tokens.name: rosette-gold
tokens.usage: Rules and seals only, never text or linework. Rules on india-ink and sandstone-red grounds. Brand pack.

tokens.name: deep-gold
tokens.usage: Gold on ivory grounds: rules, and display text 24px and up only (4.3:1 on marble-ivory). Brand pack.

tokens.name: deccani-teal
tokens.usage: Secondary: section grounds, data, links on marble-ivory (7.0:1); takes marble-ivory text. Brand pack.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and surface background.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on ground, 15.0:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Running body text on ground; 15.0:1 ivory, 10.2:1 ink.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The acronym, the mark and primary headings on ground. Turns ivory on ink, as in the reversed lockup.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The gold rule separating content from signature.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, as in the lockup divider (ink at 20 percent). Decorative only.

tokens.name: on-sandstone
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a sandstone-red field (5.8:1).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Film titles, covers, event backdrops. Proposed scale.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles, lecture titles. Proposed scale.

styles.name: heading
